config.title: Pi Code Gui
config.promptToInstall: Prompt to install Pi if not found
config.anthropicApiKey: Anthropic API key for Claude models (overrides env var at runtime)
config.openaiApiKey: OpenAI API key for GPT models (overrides env var at runtime)
config.systemPromptAppend: Additional instructions appended to the pi system prompt
config.enableSkills: Load project and global pi skills
config.enableContextFiles: Inject project context files (AGENTS.md, inferred project guidelines)
config.defaultModelProvider: Default model provider (e.g. 'anthropic'). Empty = auto-detect first available.
config.defaultModelId: Default model ID (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-5'). Requires defaultModelProvider to be set.
config.defaultThinkingLevel: Default thinking level for new sessions
config.contextBudget: Per-session token budget. 0 = use model default. Increase for longer conversations before auto-compaction.
config.sessionDir: Custom directory for session .jsonl files. Empty = pi SDK default (~/.pi/agent/sessions/).
config.autoOpenOnStart: Automatically open the Pi chat tab when VS Code starts. When disabled, sessions initialize in the background.
